hints.one_liner: /resume -- pick up a previous session where you left off
hints.note: Claude Code saves session state between runs

hints.one_liner: /model sonnet -- switch model for cheaper routine work
hints.note: Sonnet is 5x cheaper than Opus for editing and bash

hints.one_liner: /permit-rollback -- undo any file change with fuzzy matching

hints.note: Keeps all file edits but compresses the conversation history
CLAUDE.md is read automatically every session -- no re-explaining needed

hints.one_liner: /clear -- fresh context when moving to a new task
hints.note: Cheaper than compacting for completely unrelated work

hints.one_liner: /permit project -- see costs and patterns across all sessions
/add-dir -- add another project directory to context
hints.note: Useful for monorepos or multi-repo work

hints.one_liner: /bug -- report this to Anthropic with full session context
hints.note: Sends a bug report with the full conversation for diagnosis

hints.one_liner: /permit config -- view and change permit settings
hints.note: Set budget, verbosity, snapshot threshold, coach preferences

obsolete_patterns.message: ANTHROPIC_MODEL env var pollutes your shell -- use /model instead
Reading settings.json manually -- /config shows settings safely
Skip-permissions flag is risky -- configure allowedTools in CLAUDE.md instead
Editing memory files directly -- use /memory commands instead
